subject: Staged go-live triggers and ownership roster
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@novametrix.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@novametrix.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP — draft items and proposed go-live windows

Thanks, Evelyn — quick note from the implementation side: we reviewed the draft MAP and need to flag two items that are blockers for our security review team (audit logs retention and KMS integration). Can we schedule a short alignment to confirm acceptance gates and a rollback trigger?

High-level asks: 
- Confirm who on Redwood will own the KMS config and which environment (staging vs prod) you'll provision for ours.
- Define clear go/no-go gates (e.g., PASSED: SOC evidence uploaded, FAILED: revert to model-variant-3).

I can do 30 mins tomorrow morning PT.

—Liam
NovaMetrix — Head of Integrations
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@novametrix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP — draft items and proposed go-live windows

Thanks for the catch, Liam — we should be explicit about owners and acceptance criteria. Draft plan attached (20270517_NovaMAP-draft.xlsx). Summary below and proposed owners: 

- KMS integration (owner: Karthik Iyer) — deliverable: key rotation policy + test key in staging. Acceptance gate: KMS keys validated by Nova security and test encryption/decryption matrix passed.
- Audit/log retention (owner: Ben Carter) — deliverable: retention policy + sample log export. Acceptance gate: retention policy signed off and one exported snapshot delivered.
- Load/latency verification (owner: Marissa Cole) — deliverable: 1-hour storm test report. Acceptance gate: P95 latency <= 450ms for 99% of requests during test.

Go-live triggers we propose (high-level): 
1) All acceptance gates green 
2) Successful smoke test in staging (redwood-provided test harness) 
3) Mutual sign-off window (48 hours) — either side can stop.

I'll book a 30-minute sync for Tue 08:30 PT. If that doesn't work, tell me a window.

Attachments: 20270517_NovaMAP-draft.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 07:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP — draft items and proposed go-live windows

Appreciate the heads-up. Quick internal alignment before the sync: 

- KMS: I'll own the config and provide the staging key by Thu EOD. Need Nova to confirm the KMS provider they require (AWS KMS vs customer HSM). Action item: Evelyn to confirm provider preference in the sync.
- Audit logs: Ben, can you scope retention export frequency (daily vs weekly) and retention window (90/180/365 days)? I'd prefer daily exports for the first 90 days.
- Test harness: Marissa, we'll need a signed test plan and load scripts. Can you draft the test script and expected metrics by Fri?

I'll include a short Runbook snippet in the sync deck that lists rollback steps (switch traffic to quantized variant, revoke staging keys).

On the Nova sync: Tue 08:30 PT works for me. 

—Karthik
Head of Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@novametrix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@novametrix.com>, Implementations <implementations@novametrix.com>
Date: Tue, 24 May 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalized triggers, owners, and go-live window (May 31 - Jun 02)

Great sync today — thanks everyone for the clear decisions. Per our notes, I pushed an updated checklist (go-live-trigger-checklist.pdf) to the Drive and summarized below. This is the authoritative MAP for the go-live window May 31 — Jun 02. Please respond with ACK by EOD Thu May 27.

Final acceptance gates & owners: 
- KMS configuration complete and test key validated (owner: karthik_iyer) — gate: Nova signs KMS validation doc.
- Audit log retention and export sample delivered (owner: ben_carter) — gate: retention doc + one exported snapshot in place.
- Staging smoke + 1-hour load run (owner: marissa_cole) — gate: P95 latency <= 450ms.
- Billing & rate-limits aligned (owner: evleny_hart) — gate: signed rate card and quota schedule.

Rollback and fallback: 
- If any gate fails within the 48-hour sign-off window we revert to standby model-variant-2 (quantized) and move customer traffic to Dedicated fallback pool. Runbook steps (high-level) included in Drive doc.

Milestone dates: 
- Thu May 27: ACK required (both sides)
- Fri May 28: KMS staging key provided by Redwood
- Mon May 31 09:00: Staging smoke + load test begins
- Tue Jun 01: Production cutover window (00:00–04:00 PT) with engineering on-call

Attachments: go-live-trigger-checklist.pdf (pdf), Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/novametrix/MAP-v2

Quick asks: 
- Liam/Priya: please reply with ACK or list of outstanding items by EOD Thu May 27.
- Marissa: send test script to implementations@novametrix.com and cc my team by Fri.

Thanks — short, concrete, and actionable.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference
